bash_commands:
["set -euo pipefail

 echo '--- Disk usage ---'
 df -h /
 echo '--- Agent-platform logrotate config ---'
 if [ -f /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf ]; then
   echo 'Found /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf'
   sed -n '1,200p' /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf
 else
   echo 'No /etc/logrotate.d/agent-platform.conf found' >&2
 fi
 echo '--- Log dirs ---'
 ls -ld /var/log /var/log/* 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,200p'
 echo '--- Agent-platform log dir listing (common guesses) ---'
 for d in /var/log/agent-platform /var/log/agent_platform /var/log/agentplatform /srv/log/agent-platform; do
   if [ -d "$d" ]; then
     echo "# Listing $d"
     find "$d" -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\t%k KB\t%TY-%Tm-%Td %TH:%TM\n' | sort
   fi
 done
 echo '--- Search for prior shift notes ---'
 for f in /root/SHIFT_NOTES /root/SHIFT_NOTES.txt /root/notes.txt /var/log/agent-platform/cleanup_summary.txt /var/log/agent-platform/cleanup-summary.txt /var/log/agent-platform/last_prune.txt /etc/motd /etc/issue; do
   if [ -f "$f" ]; then
     echo "# Contents of $f"
     sed -n '1,200p' "$f"
   fi
 done
", "set -euo pipefail
# Ensure locale for predictable tooling
export LC_ALL=C

# Directories
LOGDIR=/var/log/agent-platform
AUDITDIR=/var/log/agent-platform/audit

# Capture pre-usage
BEFORE_USED_KB=$(df -k --output=used / | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')

# Prepare temp files
DELLIST=$(mktemp)
COMPLIST=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$DELLIST" "$COMPLIST"' EXIT

# Build deletion list: files older than 30 days
if [ -d "$LOGDIR" ]; then
  find "$LOGDIR" "$AUDITDIR" -xdev -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -print0 2>/dev/null > "$DELLIST" || true
  find "$LOGDIR" "$AUDITDIR" -xdev -type f -name '*.log.*' -mtime +30 -print0 2>/dev/null >> "$DELLIST" || true
fi

# Compute delete counts and size (bytes)
DEL_COUNT=0
DEL_BYTES=0
if [ -s "$DELLIST" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    DEL_COUNT=$((DEL_COUNT+1))
    # Use stat; if missing, skip
    if [ -e "$f" ]; then
      sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
      DEL_BYTES=$((DEL_BYTES+sz))
    fi
  done < "$DELLIST"
fi

# Build compression list: .log files older than 7 days and not already compressed
if [ -d "$LOGDIR" ]; then
  find "$LOGDIR" "$AUDITDIR" -xdev -type f -name '*.log' ! -name '*.gz' -mtime +7 -print0 2>/dev/null > "$COMPLIST" || true
fi

# Remove any files that are also slated for deletion from the compression list (older than 30d)
if [ -s "$DELLIST" ] && [ -s "$COMPLIST" ]; then
  TMP=$(mktemp)
  # Build a grep-safe pattern of files to delete
  # Use comm -23 to subtract lists; requires sorted lines without NUL, so convert safely by using perl to null->newline and back later
  perl -0ne 'print' "$COMPLIST" | sort -u > "$TMP.1"
  perl -0ne 'print' "$DELLIST"  | sort -u > "$TMP.2"
  COMBINED=$(mktemp)
  comm -23 "$TMP.1" "$TMP.2" > "$COMBINED" || true
  # Convert back to NUL-delimited list
  tr '\n' '\0' < "$COMBINED" > "$COMPLIST"
  rm -f "$TMP.1" "$TMP.2" "$COMBINED" "$TMP"
fi

# Compute compression counts and total pre-compress bytes
COMP_COUNT=0
COMP_BYTES_BEFORE=0
if [ -s "$COMPLIST" ]; then
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    COMP_COUNT=$((COMP_COUNT+1))
    sz=$(stat -c '%s' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    COMP_BYTES_BEFORE=$((COMP_BYTES_BEFORE+sz))
  done < "$COMPLIST"
fi

# Perform deletions
if [ "$DEL_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  xargs -0r rm -f -- < "$DELLIST"
fi

# Perform compressions (use gzip -9, keep original replaced)
COMP_BYTES_AFTER=0
if [ "$COMP_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
  # gzip each file; after compression, accumulate sizes of resulting .gz files
  while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    if [ -e "$f" ]; then
      gzip -9 "$f" || true
      if [ -e "$f.gz" ]; then
        sz_after=$(stat -c '%s' "$f.gz" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
        COMP_BYTES_AFTER=$((COMP_BYTES_AFTER+sz_after))
      fi
    fi
  done < "$COMPLIST"
fi

# Capture post-usage
AFTER_USED_KB=$(df -k --output=used / | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
FREED_KB=$(( BEFORE_USED_KB - AFTER_USED_KB ))
[ $FREED_KB -lt 0 ] && FREED_KB=0

# Human-readable helpers
hr_bytes() {
  awk -v b="$1" 'BEGIN{ split("B KB MB GB TB",u); s=1; while (b>=1024 && s<5){b/=1024; s++} printf (s==1?"%d %s":"%.1f %s"), b, u[s] }'
}

DEL_HR=$(hr_bytes "$DEL_BYTES")
COMP_SAVED_BYTES=$(( COMP_BYTES_BEFORE - COMP_BYTES_AFTER ))
[ $COMP_SAVED_BYTES -lt 0 ] && COMP_SAVED_BYTES=0
COMP_BEFORE_HR=$(hr_bytes "$COMP_BYTES_BEFORE")
COMP_AFTER_HR=$(hr_bytes "$COMP_BYTES_AFTER")
COMP_SAVED_HR=$(hr_bytes "$COMP_SAVED_BYTES")
FREED_HR=$(hr_bytes $((FREED_KB*1024)) )

# Prepare one-line summary
TS=$(date -u +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')
SUMMARY="$TS deleted ${DEL_COUNT} files (>30d, ${DEL_HR}); compressed ${COMP_COUNT} files (>7d, ${COMP_BEFORE_HR} -> ${COMP_AFTER_HR}, saved ${COMP_SAVED_HR}); disk freed ~${FREED_HR}."

# Write summary to a standard location
mkdir -p "$LOGDIR"
echo "$SUMMARY" > "$LOGDIR/last_prune.txt"

# Output summary and a brief listing of what was deleted (first few paths) for console visibility
echo "$SUMMARY"
echo "Deleted files:" 
if [ -s "$DELLIST" ]; then
  # Recompute list as printable (it was consumed by rm)
  find "$LOGDIR" "$AUDITDIR" -xdev -type f -name '*.log' -mtime +30 -print 2>/dev/null || true
  find "$LOGDIR" "$AUDITDIR" -xdev -type f -name '*.log.*' -mtime +30 -print 2>/dev/null || true
else
  echo "(none)"
fi
", "set -euo pipefail

df -h /

printf '\nSummary file contents:\n'
cat /var/log/agent-platform/last_prune.txt
"]
